title: The Generation That Will Rebuild Ukraine Is Already Being Shaped by War
dek: For young Ukrainians, reconstruction is no longer an abstract postwar question. It is becoming a generational project.
author: OLEKSANDR MELNYK
body:
International affairs are often described from far away. Deadline Journal begins from the opposite premise: political stories become clearer when we start with the people, institutions and historical memories closest to them.
